title: Members
description: Invite the Marketing or QC team, approve join requests, set or remove a contributor team, and choose which projects each person can see.
emptyHint: Members and invites will show up here.

invites.title: Invite Marketing or QC
invites.hint: Click Invite Marketing or Invite QC, pick the projects the invited person will see, then create the link. They open it, sign up or sign in and send a join request; once you approve, they join that team and get the chosen projects right away. Both teams have the same rights: send requests and comments that wait for your approval.
invites.linkHint: Shown only once, copy it and send it to the invited person.
